dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: You're here! Oh, you're not him...

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. I am waiting for... um...

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: I'm waiting for the boss lady's nephew. He can't really hold his alcohol, but he's pretty good at cards.

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: I brought some nice booze to share with him, but he isn't in. What a pity.

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: I was planning to have a look at... at that funky deck of his.

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: *sigh* Why do people have to work? There's no time to eat, drink, and play with friends when you're working.

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: Nah, it's fine. Guess I'll wait a little longer...

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: Probably. He does sometimes say "I'm not an idler, buddy." Then he would deal with the affairs of the hotel business.

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: *sigh* Drinking alone is really not fun. Not to mention it's also a waste of the delicious grilled meat. Why don't you take it while it's still fresh?

dialogues.speaker: Nasir
dialogues.text: Find a friend to share this with. Don't be like me...
